news.headline: MAJOR FLOODING FRI — NWS Melbourne Flood Warning remains in effect until further notice for the St. Johns River near Cocoa: stage was 18.7 ft at 1:15 PM Fri, forecast to hold steady at 18.8 ft into early next week, more than a foot above the 1953 record of 17.6 ft (flood stage 16.0 ft); Flood Watch for east-central Florida including Orange, Seminole, Volusia and Brevard through Fri 7 PM
news.source: National Weather Service, Melbourne / Florida Today

news.headline: The Cade tops out in downtown St. Pete — seven-story, 15-residence boutique condo at 749 Burlington Avenue North overlooking Mirror Lake, by Backstreets Capital, seven months after breaking ground in April; occupancy expected early 2028

Miami-Dade home sales up 4% year to date through October at 18,494, but October sales fell 10.6% year over year to 1,689 as mortgage rates climbed; single-family median rose 3.52% to $706,000, condo median slipped 0.63% to $397,500
news.source: MIAMI REALTORS® + RWorld / South Florida Agent Magazine

news.headline: Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition, with new flood documentation and coastal corrosion rules

Copper selloff deepens Fri — COMEX copper ended the week down 9.91% at $5.4770/lb, down 14.80 cents (2.63%) on Fri Nov 20; LME copper closed down 1.37% at $12,453/ton in overnight trading, after a sharp mid-November drop

MasTec to acquire Murphy Corporation for about $1.25 billion in cash — Murphy, a large mechanical contractor with HVAC, plumbing and process work for mission-critical markets, is projected to generate about $775 million in 2026 revenue and about $140 million in Adjusted EBITDA, with about 1,600 employees including about 1,200 union craft professionals

Fed minutes read hawkish — almost all October FOMC participants judged further rate hikes likely to return inflation to 2%; funds held at 3.75–4.00% in a 10–2 vote, next meeting Dec 8–9, with markets pricing about 95% odds of a December hike

Markets plunge again Fri afternoon — by about 3:20 PM ET the S&P 500 was down 3.1%, the Dow down 1.3% (643 points) and the Nasdaq down 4.7%, tipping the S&P and Dow into correction territory and wiping out the Nasdaq's 2026 gains; Freddie Mac said the 30-year fixed mortgage averaged 7.28% for the week ending Nov 19, up 17 basis points from 7.11%

NBA: Heat 137, Bucks 130 on Wed night — Giannis Antetokounmpo 27 pts, 13 reb, 9 ast for Miami in his first game against his former team, Bam Adebayo 26 pts, Miami's sixth straight win; 76ers 121, Magic 116 — Joel Embiid 26 pts, VJ Edgecombe 24, halting Orlando's four-game winning streak; Magic (6-8, 2-0 in NBA Cup) play tonight Fri Nov 20 at the Brooklyn Nets, 7:30 PM ET
NFL Sun Nov 22 — all Florida teams on the road: Buccaneers at Lions 1 PM ET (FOX), Dolphins at Bills 1 PM ET (CBS), Jaguars at Giants 4:25 PM ET (CBS)
